aditya: FYI onboarding Halley-13B (mistral-ish arch) — int4 quant build shows a consistent chat summarization quality drop vs fp16. Rouge-L ~35.2 -> 30.7. Anybody seen kv-cache warmup or rotary scaling leakage cause anything like this? repro attached :thinking:
marta: can you paste the eval command + a small sample? also which quant tool (our int4 pipeline or third-party)? :eyes:
aditya: (typo) sorry aditya^^ using our int4 pipeline (quantize_v2), reproducible on dedciated node. repro command:
```
python tools/eval_chat.py --model=halley-13b-int4 --tokenizer=halley-tok-v1 --task=summarize --batch=8 --max_len=1024 --output=out.json
```
metrics snapshot:
- fp16: rouge-L 35.2, rouge-1 42.0
- int4: rouge-L 30.7, rouge-1 37.9
(repeatable across seeds)
ryan: quick guesses: 1) rotary frequency scaling mismatch, 2) kv-cache index offset (token id shift), 3) attention proj layout issue after quant/proj reorder. did you run tokenmap conversion check?
aditya: not yet. tokenizer vocab seems same size but model conversion script emits warnings about "pad token index mapping" during conversion. small log snippet:
```
WARN: token_map: pad idx 1 -> 0 (remapped)
WARN: rotary_freq: saved_scale 1.0 current_scale 0.999938
```
samantha: pad remap + tiny rotary scale drift can compound in long-context chat cases. try running the tokenmap roundtrip test and a kvcache warmup disabled run. can you try: `--kv_warmup=false` and `--rotary_scale=1.0` flags?
aditya: running now on a small partition, will post numbers shortly.
ci-bot: Started job eval/halley13b-int4/kvwarmup-test (id: 11823) — logs will stream to /ci/builds/11823 :rocket:
aditya: quick run results (single eval pass):
- int4 (baseline): rouge-L 30.7
- int4 (--kv_warmup=false): rouge-L 33.9
- int4 (--kv_warmup=false --rotary_scale=1.0): rouge-L 34.8
so disabling kv warmup recovers most of the gap; rotary_scale tweak recovers additional ~1 point.
marta: excellent signal. suggests kv-cache warmup may be writing stale K/V offsets that interact with quant noise. can you dump the first-step K/V checksums and a tokenid histogram for the failing runs? also attach a short prompt that triggers the worst drop.
aditya: posting two short reproducer prompts in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/halley-int4-repro ; checksum snippet:
```
step0_k_sum: 0x7f3a1c..
step1_k_sum: 0x9a2b4f..
token_hist: {"0": 1023, "1": 40, "100": 12} // pad heavy
```
ryan: next steps: (a) bisect conversion script to see where pad idx remap happens, (b) add guard in int4 runtime to avoid applying kv_warmup when token map remap detected, (c) schedule small quant sweep for rotary_scale sensitivity. volunteers?
samantha: I can take (b) and add a runtime flag + warning. I'll open a PR with a small repro check that refuses kv_warmup if token_map.remapped == true.
marta: I will bisect conversion script (a). aditya can you collect a short timeline of conversion tool versions used? put in the issue.
aditya: done — version pinned in gist + conversion logs. assigning to marta.
ci-bot: Created issue RED-ML-842: "Halley-13B int4: kv_warmup interacts with token_map remap -> quality regression" (assignee: marta)
aditya: thanks — we'll keep int4 disabled for Halley on hosted until fix. tagging folks for visibility @marta @samantha :thumbsup:
